title: List of conspiracy theories — Death of Nero
text:
Title: List of conspiracy theories — Death of Nero

In ancient times, widespread conspiracy theories were circulated pertaining to the death of the 
Roman emperor Nero, who killed himself in 68 AD. Some of these theories claimed that Nero had actually faked 
his death and was secretly still alive, but in hiding, plotting to reestablish his reign. In most of these stories,
 he was said to have fled to the East, where he was still influential. Other theories held that Nero would return from the dead to retake his throne.
  Many early Christians feared Nero's return to resume his vicious anti-Christian persecutions. The Book of Revelation may allude to these conspiracy 
  theories in its description of the slaughtered head returned to life.
